exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture and correct the sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang va gaplarni to'g'rilang, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMDA PLYAJ MANZARASI:
  Ann   — qizil soyabon ostida gitara chalayapti
  Sue   — dengizda suzayapti
  Molly — dengizda suzayapti
  Jim   — qumdan qal'a yasayapti (chelak va belcha bor)
  Ian   — Jim bilan birga qumdan qal'a yasayapti
  Tony  — toshda o'tirib baliq tutayapti
  Patty — sochiq ustida yotib quyoshda toblanayapti

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  Patty is swimming.
     Wrong! Patty isn't swimming. She's sunbathing.

JAVOB TUZILISHI (uch qism):
  1) Wrong!
  2) Ism + isn't/aren't + noto'g'ri fe'l-ing.
  3) He's/She's/They're + TO'G'RI fe'l-ing.

DIQQAT: 3-qismda ISM o'rniga OLMOSH ishlatiladi:
  Patty → She's;  Tony → He's;  Sue and Molly → They're

items.answer: Wrong! Patty isn't swimming. She's sunbathing.
items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. Patti sochiqda yotib quyoshda toblanayapti.

items.textEn: 2  Sue and Molly are playing tennis.
items.answer: Wrong! Sue and Molly aren't playing tennis. They're swimming.
items.whyUz:
Ikki kishi → AREN'T va THEY'RE.
Syu va Molli dengizda suzayapti.

items.answer: Wrong! Ann isn't sleeping. She's playing the guitar.
items.whyUz:
Ann soyabon ostida o'tirib gitara chalayapti.
DIQQAT: cholg'u asbobi oldida THE shart — play THE guitar.

items.answer: Wrong! Tony isn't listening to music. He's fishing.
items.hintUz: Toni toshda o'tiribdi, qo'lida uzun tayoq
items.whyUz:
Toni qarmoq bilan baliq tutayapti.
'to fish' = baliq tutmoq → 'fishing'.

items.textEn: 5  Jim and Ian are reading a book.
items.answer: Wrong! Jim and Ian aren't reading a book. They're making a sandcastle.
items.hintUz: Ular qumda, yonlarida chelak va belcha bor
items.whyUz:
Jim va Ian qumdan qal'a yasashayapti.
Ikki kishi → AREN'T va THEY'RE.

exercises.instructionEn: First, listen to the sounds and tick what you hear, then ask and answer questions, as in the example.

exercises.audioRequiredUz: Qaysi variant belgilanishi faqat kassetadagi tovush bilan aniqlanadi. Kitobda faqat 1-band belgilangan (play tennis). Quyida har bir band uchun IKKALA variantning javobi berilgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: Is Tony watching TV?
  S2: No, he isn't. He's playing tennis.

QOLIP:
  SAVOL:  Is/Are + ega + fe'l-ING?
  JAVOB:  No, he isn't/she isn't/they aren't. + He's/She's/They're + to'g'ri fe'l-ing.

Savolda BELGILANMAGAN variant so'raladi,
javobda esa BELGILANGAN variant aytiladi.

OLMOSHLAR:
  Tony → he;  Stella → she;  James → he
  Bob & Keith → they;  They → they;  She → she

items.question: Is Tony watching TV?
items.answer: No, he isn't. He's playing tennis.
items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna — 'play tennis' belgilangan.

items.prompt: 2  Stella: drive a car / have a shower — agar 'have a shower' belgilansa
items.question: Is Stella driving a car?
items.answer: No, she isn't. She's having a shower.
items.whyUz:
'have a shower' = dush qabul qilmoq → 'having a shower'.
DIQQAT: 'have' bu yerda 'ega bo'lmoq' emas — shuning uchun -ing shakli MUMKIN.

items.prompt: 2  Stella: drive a car / have a shower — agar 'drive a car' belgilansa
items.question: Is Stella having a shower?
items.answer: No, she isn't. She's driving a car.
items.whyUz: 'drive' -e bilan tugaydi → e tushadi: driving.

items.prompt: 3  Bob & Keith: swim / sleep — agar 'sleep' belgilansa
items.question: Are Bob and Keith swimming?
items.answer: No, they aren't. They're sleeping.
items.whyUz:
Ikki kishi → ARE va THEY.
'swim' → swimming (m ikkilanadi).

items.prompt: 3  Bob & Keith: swim / sleep — agar 'swim' belgilansa
items.question: Are Bob and Keith sleeping?
items.answer: No, they aren't. They're swimming.
items.whyUz: 'sleep' → sleeping (oddiy -ing).

items.prompt: 4  They: listen to music / play computer games — agar 'play computer games' belgilansa
items.question: Are they listening to music?
items.answer: No, they aren't. They're playing computer games.
items.whyUz: 'listen TO music' — 'to' predlogi shart.

items.prompt: 4  They: listen to music / play computer games — agar 'listen to music' belgilansa
items.question: Are they playing computer games?
items.answer: No, they aren't. They're listening to music.
items.whyUz: 'computer games' — kompyuter o'yinlari.

items.prompt: 5  James: ride a horse / ride a motorbike — agar 'ride a motorbike' belgilansa
items.question: Is James riding a horse?
items.answer: No, he isn't. He's riding a motorbike.
items.whyUz:
'ride' -e bilan tugaydi → riding.
'a motorbike' = mototsikl.

items.prompt: 5  James: ride a horse / ride a motorbike — agar 'ride a horse' belgilansa
items.question: Is James riding a motorbike?
items.answer: No, he isn't. He's riding a horse.
items.whyUz: 'ride a horse' = otga minmoq.

items.prompt: 6  She: play the guitar / play the piano — agar 'play the piano' belgilansa
items.question: Is she playing the guitar?
items.answer: No, she isn't. She's playing the piano.
items.whyUz: Cholg'u asbobi oldida THE shart: play THE piano.

items.prompt: 6  She: play the guitar / play the piano — agar 'play the guitar' belgilansa
items.question: Is she playing the piano?
items.answer: No, she isn't. She's playing the guitar.
items.whyUz: 15-mashqdagi Ann ham gitara chalayapti.

items.question: Are they walking?
items.answer: No, they aren't. They're running.
items.whyUz: 'run' → running (n IKKILANADI).

items.question: Are they running?
items.answer: No, they aren't. They're walking.
items.whyUz: 'walk' → walking (oddiy -ing). 'l' o'qilmaydi: /wɔːk/.

sections.title: Reading & Listening — seasons around the world
sections.titleUz: O'qish va tinglash — dunyo mamlakatlaridagi fasllar

exercises.explanationUz:
A MATNI — BRITANIYA (Karen)

2-RASM: somon tomli eski inglizcha uy, atrofida gullar va
yashil o't — bahor manzarasi.

BRITANIYA IQLIMI:
  yil bo'yi — ko'p yomg'ir
  qish      — juda sovuq va shamolli
  kuz, bahor — ancha shamolli, lekin juda sovuq emas
  yoz       — ancha iliq, lekin bulutli ham bo'lishi mumkin

sentences.en: In Britain the weather is often rainy, but in winter it's also very cold and windy.
sentences.uz: Britaniyada ob-havo ko'pincha yomg'irli, lekin qishda juda sovuq va shamolli ham bo'ladi.

sentences.en: In autumn and spring it can be quite windy but it's not very cold.
sentences.uz: Kuz va bahorda ancha shamolli bo'lishi mumkin, lekin juda sovuq emas.
sentences.noteUz:
'can be' = bo'lishi mumkin (ehtimollik).
'quite' = ancha (44-betdagi daraja so'zi).

sentences.en: Summer can be quite warm but it can also be cloudy.
sentences.uz: Yoz ancha iliq bo'lishi mumkin, lekin bulutli ham bo'lishi mumkin.

sentences.en: I like spring a lot because the trees are green and there are lots of flowers.
sentences.uz: Menga bahor juda yoqadi, chunki daraxtlar yashil va gullar ko'p bo'ladi.
sentences.noteUz:
SEVIMLI FASL VA SABABI.
'a lot' = juda (fe'ldan keyin).
'lots of' = ko'p.

sentences.en: I often go for walks in the park, then.
sentences.uz: Shunda men ko'pincha bog'da sayr qilaman.
sentences.noteUz:
'go for a walk' = sayrga chiqmoq (ko'plikda: go for walks).
'then' bu yerda = o'sha paytda, o'shanda.

exercises.explanationUz:
B MATNI — BRAZILIYA (Migel)

1-RASM: tog' va shahar fonidagi plyaj, ko'p odam —
Rio-de-Janeyro (Braziliya).

BRAZILIYA IQLIMI:
  umumiy   — iliq iqlim
  qish     — juda sovuq emas
  bahor, kuz — iliq, lekin yomg'irli
  yoz      — deyarli doim issiq va quyoshli

DIQQAT: Braziliya JANUBIY yarim sharda — fasllar
Britaniyanikiga TESKARI.

sentences.noteUz:
'a climate' = iqlim (uzoq muddatli ob-havo).
'weather' esa — bugungi ob-havo. Farqiga e'tibor bering.
Fasl oldida THE ishlatilishi ham mumkin: 'the winter'.

sentences.en: In spring and autumn it is warm, but rainy.
sentences.uz: Bahor va kuzda iliq, lekin yomg'irli bo'ladi.

sentences.en: In summer it's nearly always hot and sunny.
sentences.uz: Yozda deyarli doim issiq va quyoshli bo'ladi.

sentences.en: Sometimes, it rains suddenly and then the sun comes out again!
sentences.uz: Ba'zan to'satdan yomg'ir yog'adi, so'ng quyosh yana chiqadi!
sentences.noteUz:
'suddenly' = to'satdan (sudden + -ly).
'the sun comes out' = quyosh chiqadi (frazali fe'l).

sentences.en: I love swimming and sunbathing at the beach.
sentences.uz: Men plyajda suzish va quyoshda toblanishni juda yaxshi ko'raman.
sentences.noteUz:
SABABI.
'love/like + fe'l-ING' — yoqtirish fe'llaridan keyin -ing keladi.

sentences.en: We have lots of fun there.
sentences.uz: Biz u yerda juda ko'p zavqlanamiz.
sentences.noteUz:
'have fun' = zavqlanmoq, ko'ngil ochmoq.
'fun' sanalmaydigan ot → 'lots of fun'.

exercises.explanationUz:
C MATNI — FINLANDIYA (Anita)

3-RASM: qorli o'rmon, yog'och uy va chang'i uchayotgan
odamlar — qish manzarasi.

FINLANDIYA IQLIMI:
  qish  — juda sovuq va JUDA UZUN;
          quyosh umuman chiqmaydigan kunlar bor
  yoz   — juda iliq, lekin KALTA;
          kunlar juda uzun, quyosh kechayu kunduz charaqlaydi

QIZIQ FAKT: Finlandiya Shimoliy qutbga yaqin.
Yozda 'oq tunlar' bo'ladi — quyosh botmaydi.
Qishda esa 'qutb tuni' — quyosh chiqmaydi.

sentences.en: In Finland the weather is very cold in the winter and very warm in the summer.
sentences.uz: Finlandiyada qishda ob-havo juda sovuq, yozda esa juda iliq bo'ladi.
sentences.noteUz: Fasl oldida 'in THE winter' — 'in winter' ham to'g'ri.

sentences.en: The winter is very long and there are days when the sun doesn't appear at all.
sentences.uz: Qish juda uzun va quyosh umuman chiqmaydigan kunlar bo'ladi.
sentences.noteUz:
'to appear' = ko'rinmoq, paydo bo'lmoq.
'not ... at all' = umuman ...emas (kuchli inkor).

sentences.en: The summer is short, but it's warm, because the days are so long.
sentences.uz: Yoz kalta, lekin iliq, chunki kunlar juda uzun.
sentences.noteUz:
'so' bu yerda = juda ('very' bilan bir xil).
'because' — sabab bog'lovchisi.

sentences.en: The sun shines all day and night for most of the summer.
sentences.uz: Yozning ko'p qismida quyosh kechayu kunduz charaqlaydi.
sentences.noteUz:
'all day and night' = kechayu kunduz.
'most of' = ko'p qismi.

sentences.en: I like winter the best because there is always snow and I often go skiing.
sentences.uz: Menga qish eng ko'p yoqadi, chunki doim qor bo'ladi va men ko'pincha chang'i uchgani boraman.
sentences.noteUz:
SEVIMLI FASL VA SABABI.
'like ... the best' = eng ko'p yoqtirmoq.
'go skiing' = chang'i uchgani bormoq ('ski' → 'skiing', ikkita i).

exercises.instructionUz: Ob-havo tavsiflarini tinglang va ularni rasmlarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH RASM:
  1 — tog' va shahar fonidagi katta plyaj, ko'p odam (issiq mamlakat)
  2 — somon tomli eski uy, gullar va yashil o't (Angliya, bahor)
  3 — qorli o'rmon, yog'och uy, chang'i uchayotgan odamlar (shimol, qish)

Har bir matn qaysi rasmga mos kelishini mamlakat va
fasl tavsifidan aniqlash mumkin — audio talab qilmaydi.

pairs.right: 2-rasm — somon tomli uy, gullar, yashil o't
pairs.whyUz:
Rasmda tipik ingliz qishlog'i uyi. Karen bahorni yaxshi ko'radi —
rasmda ham gullar va yashil daraxtlar bor.

Rasmda Rio-de-Janeyro plyaji. Migel yozni va plyajda suzishni
yaxshi ko'radi.

pairs.right: 3-rasm — qorli o'rmon va chang'i uchayotgan odamlar
pairs.whyUz:
Rasmda qor va chang'ichilar. Anita qishni yaxshi ko'radi va
ko'pincha chang'i uchgani boradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts and say which season each person likes most, and why. Finally, talk about the seasons in your country.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnlarni o'qing va har bir odam qaysi faslni eng ko'p yoqtirishini hamda nima uchun ekanini ayting. Nihoyat, o'z mamlakatingizdagi fasllar haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
SEVIMLI FASLNI IFODALASH USULLARI (uch matndan):
  I like spring A LOT because ...
  Summer is MY FAVOURITE SEASON. I love ...
  I like winter THE BEST because ...

Uchalasi ham bir xil ma'noda.

SABAB DOIM 'because' bilan beriladi.

items.answer: She likes spring most.
items.whyUz: Karen: 'I like spring a lot ...'

items.answer: Because the trees are green and there are lots of flowers. She often goes for walks in the park then.
items.whyUz:
Karen: 'because the trees are green and there are lots of flowers.
I often go for walks in the park, then.'

items.answer: He likes summer most. Summer is his favourite season.
items.whyUz: Migel: 'Summer is my favourite season.'

items.answer: Because he loves swimming and sunbathing at the beach. They have lots of fun there.
items.whyUz:
Migel: 'I love swimming and sunbathing at the beach.
We have lots of fun there.'
Yozda 'nearly always hot and sunny' bo'lishi ham sabab.

items.answer: She likes winter the best.
items.whyUz: Anita: 'I like winter the best ...'

items.answer: Because there is always snow and she often goes skiing.
items.whyUz: Anita: 'because there is always snow and I often go skiing.'

items.answer: In winter it is cold and it sometimes snows.
items.whyUz:
O'zbekistonda qish sovuq, ba'zan qor yog'adi.
Qolip: In winter it is + sifat.

items.answer: In spring it is warm and it often rains. The trees are green and there are lots of flowers.
items.whyUz: Bahor iliq va yomg'irli. Karenning matnidagi iboralardan foydalaning.

items.answer: In summer it is very hot and sunny. It hardly ever rains.
items.whyUz:
O'zbekistonda yoz juda issiq va quruq.
'hardly ever' = deyarli hech qachon.

items.answer: In autumn it is cool and quite rainy.
items.whyUz: Kuz salqin va yomg'irli. 'cool' = salqin (50-betdagi shkala).

sections.title: Writing (Project) — the seasons in my country

exercises.instructionEn: Write a short paragraph about the different seasons in your country. Write which is your favourite season and what you like doing then. Use the texts in Ex. 17 as models.
exercises.instructionUz: O'z mamlakatingizdagi turli fasllar haqida qisqa xatboshi yozing. Qaysi fasl sevimli ekanini va o'shanda nima qilishni yoqtirishingizni yozing. 17-mashqdagi matnlarni namuna qilib oling.
exercises.explanationUz:
17-MASHQ MATNLARI TUZILISHI (uchalasida ham bir xil):

  1) Mamlakat iqlimi haqida umumiy gap
  2) Har bir fasl haqida bir-ikki gap
  3) Sevimli fasl
  4) NIMA UCHUN (because ...)
  5) O'shanda nima qilishni yoqtirishi

FOYDALI IBORALAR:
  ... has a warm/cold climate.
  In winter it is ... / In summer it's ...
  It can be quite ...
  ... is my favourite season.
  I like ... the best because ...
  I love/like + fe'l-ING
  I often go for walks / go skiing / go swimming

structure.modelEn: Uzbekistan has a continental climate with four different seasons.
structure.noteUz:
'a continental climate' = kontinental iqlim.
Migelning matni ham shunday boshlanadi: 'Brazil has a warm climate.'

structure.modelEn: In winter it is cold and windy, and it sometimes snows.
In spring it is warm and it often rains, so the trees are green and there are lots of flowers.
In summer it is very hot and sunny, and it hardly ever rains.
In autumn it is cool and quite rainy, but it is not very cold.
I like it the best because the weather is warm and everything is green.
I love going for walks in the park and having picnics with my family.

Uzbekistan has a continental climate with four different seasons. In winter it is cold and windy, and it sometimes snows. In spring it is warm and it often rains, so the trees are green and there are lots of flowers. In summer it is very hot and sunny, and it hardly ever rains. In autumn it is cool and quite rainy, but it is not very cold. Spring is my favourite season. I like it the best because the weather is warm and everything is green. I love going for walks in the park and having picnics with my family.
structure.noteUz: Taxminan 80 so'z — 17-mashqdagi matnlar bilan bir xil hajm.

wordFormation.introUz: 51-bet — mashg'ulot fe'llari va sevimli narsani ifodalash.

groups.explanationUz: 17-mashqdagi uch matnda uch xil qolip ishlatilgan.
like, love, hate, enjoy, prefer fe'llaridan keyin ikkinchi fe'l -ing bilan keladi.
Ikkalasi ham ob-havo haqida, lekin muddati boshqa.

patterns.formula: Wrong! X isn't/aren't + fe'l-ING. He's/She's/They're + to'g'ri fe'l-ING.
patterns.exampleEn: Wrong! Patty isn't swimming. She's sunbathing.
patterns.exampleUz: Noto'g'ri! Patti suzmayapti. U quyoshda toblanayapti.
patterns.explanationUz: Avval inkor (ismi bilan), keyin to'g'ri javob (olmosh bilan).

patterns.formula: Is/Are + ega + fe'l-ING? — No, ... isn't/aren't. + to'g'ri javob.
patterns.exampleEn: Is Tony watching TV? — No, he isn't. He's playing tennis.
patterns.exampleUz: Toni televizor ko'ryaptimi? — Yo'q. U tennis o'ynayapti.
patterns.explanationUz: Qisqa inkor javobdan keyin to'g'ri ma'lumot beriladi.

patterns.formula: In + fasl + it is / it's + sifat.
patterns.exampleEn: In summer it's nearly always hot and sunny.
patterns.exampleUz: Yozda deyarli doim issiq va quyoshli bo'ladi.

patterns.exampleEn: In autumn and spring it can be quite windy.
patterns.exampleUz: Kuz va bahorda ancha shamolli bo'lishi mumkin.
patterns.explanationUz: 'can be' — doim emas, ba'zan shunday bo'lishi mumkin.

patterns.formula: X is my favourite season. / I like X the best BECAUSE ...
patterns.exampleEn: Summer is my favourite season. I like winter the best because there is always snow.
patterns.exampleUz: Yoz — sevimli faslim. Menga qish eng ko'p yoqadi, chunki doim qor bo'ladi.

patterns.exampleEn: I love swimming and sunbathing at the beach.
patterns.exampleUz: Men plyajda suzish va quyoshda toblanishni yaxshi ko'raman.
patterns.explanationUz: love, like, enjoy, hate fe'llaridan keyin ikkinchi fe'l -ING bilan.

patterns.formula: I often GO FOR walks / GO skiing / GO swimming.
patterns.exampleEn: I often go for walks in the park. I often go skiing.
patterns.exampleUz: Men ko'pincha bog'da sayr qilaman. Ko'pincha chang'i uchgani boraman.
patterns.explanationUz:
'go for a walk' — 'for' bilan.
'go skiing/swimming' — to'g'ridan-to'g'ri -ing bilan.
